name: Primitives in a tray (Isaac Replicator)
description: A neutral tray with cubes, cylinders and spheres under a dome and a key light, seen by a fixed overhead camera. Each run places a new random set of objects; each view of a run varies the lighting. Writes one canonical session: RGB, depth, instance masks and tight 2-D boxes.

seed.label: Seed
seed.help: The master seed. The same seed and settings record the same scenes (the rendered pixels are not promised identical).

runs.label: Runs
runs.help: Randomized scenes. Each scene is one split group: its views never end up in different splits.

views.label: Views per run
views.help: Renders of each scene under different lighting.

parameters.label: Objects per run
parameters.help: How many objects a scene draws (fewer are placed when the tray is full).

parameters.label: Object size
parameters.help: Edge of a cube, diameter of a cylinder or sphere.

parameters.label: Ambient light
parameters.help: Dome light intensity, drawn per view.

parameters.label: Key light
parameters.help: Directional light intensity, drawn per view.

parameters.label: Colour variation
parameters.help: Each RGB channel of an object's colour is drawn within this range.

parameters.label: Key light elevation
parameters.help: Angle of the directional light above the floor, drawn per view.

parameters.label: Key light azimuth
parameters.help: Direction of the directional light, drawn per view.

parameters.label: Camera height
parameters.help: The fixed overhead camera's height above the tray floor. The whole tray must stay in view.

parameters.label: Tray inner size
parameters.help: Inner length and width of the tray.

parameters.label: Resolution
parameters.help: Width x height of the rendered images.

parameters.label: Render subframes
parameters.help: Renderer subframes per captured frame: higher is cleaner and slower.

parameters.label: Settle frames
parameters.help: Frames rendered after every scene or lighting change before the captured one. Too few leaves faint ghosts of the previous scene in the RGB.
